decision_rule: Pass only if M3034 writes a design artifact that freezes the active-safety driver objective, metrics, benchmark roles, candidate baselines, exclusions, guardrails, and one next route without overclaiming.
failure_criteria: M3034 treats design-only baseline freeze as driver performance
M3034 leaves benchmark roles metrics or candidate baselines ambiguous
M3034 adds hidden oracle diagnostic actor inputs
M3034 runs training validation ranking promotion high-fidelity rollout or self-ID verdicts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden dynamics mu slip tire force oracle feasibility TTC reference trajectory or precomputed verdict labels to actor input
do not claim driver performance from design-only baseline freeze
do not allow legacy self-ID proof gates to veto all engineering progress unless they expose direct safety regression
do not run high-fidelity validation before backend source/package and P0 mapping are auditable
do not train fit rank or promote checkpoints in M3034
hypothesis: A bounded Active Safety Driver v1 baseline-freeze design can define the official engineering baseline, benchmark roles, metric families, candidate checkpoint list, exclusion rules, and stop conditions before any training architecture comparison horizon/K-candidate ablation high-fidelity validation ranking promotion paper or self-ID claim.

parent_objective: freeze Active Safety Driver v1 engineering baseline before more fitting or proof work

self-ID proof gate as the active-safety engineering mainline blocker
